message: x-fern-pagination: false does not disable pagination: Fern treats it like true and applies the document-level x-fern-pagination. Remove the extension instead.
x-fern-pagination: false inherits the document-level x-fern-pagination, but the document does not declare one, so Fern generates no pagination for endpoint listGroups.
x-fern-pagination: true inherits the document-level x-fern-pagination, but the document does not declare one, so Fern generates no pagination for endpoint listUsers.
